The invariant-5 concern is vendor SELL COPY inside client content, which the r_layer and storyline_challenge assertions below already cover. A check that fails on the logo would have been switched off within a day.

Gate C already proves the bundle contains no bare em-dash render fallback; what remains are em dashes inside PRODUCER PROSE, which `dashes()` normalises to hyphens on the paths it reaches and evidently not on all of them. Pinned to what is actually there rather than to a round number, so the debt cannot grow quietly and shrinks visibly — same discipline as the corpus ceiling ratchet in scripts/gate_b_ceiling_ratchet.py. Lower it as the paths are fixed; never raise it.
